milestones.title: An attested model server of your organization's at a site declared in Canada
A Cohere Encrypted vault in Canada, once Cohere offers the region
One attested model service in Canada is listed in your organization's rules

remediation: Data in use has no approved encryption (ITSP.10.033 SA-400(6)), so where AI runs is judged by location and operator. No attested service runs in Canada today: your organization's attested hosting is Phase 74.2, Cohere's Encrypted vault runs only in the US (Phase 37 waits on a Canadian region), and NEAR AI states no locations (G527). Until one exists, Protected B work that needs attested hosting stays on this computer or on your organization's own server at a site declared in Canada. Sovereignty: ai-runs.
title: No attested model service runs in Canada
